profile_about_body: Tashila connects you with truck transport in Tamanrasset — clear prices, single or double cabine options, and reliable drivers for your goods.
profile_faq_body:
• Pick pickup and drop-off on the map or search for an area.
• Choose cabine type to match your load.
• Pay in cash at the end of the trip and rate your driver.
• Your trip history is saved in the History tab.

profile_legal_tips_body:
• Book pickup and drop-off as precisely as you can.
• Be available when the driver arrives to avoid waiting charges.
• Check your load stays within the truck weight limit (700 kg).
• Keep payment ready in cash unless your driver agrees otherwise.
• Rate your trip honestly — it helps everyone.
profile_legal_terms_body: Tashila connects you with transport services for your goods. By using the app you confirm you are legally allowed to ship your goods, that descriptions are accurate, and that you accept transport at your own risk for fragile or hazardous items unless explicitly agreed with the carrier. Prices shown are estimates; final price may change with waiting time or route changes. We may update these terms; continued use means acceptance of the latest version.
profile_legal_privacy_body: Tashila stores your profile and trip history to operate the service. Location is used when you request pickup or search places. We do not sell your data. If you delete your account, your profile data is removed according to our retention policy.
